bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new animal hospital and asset preservation at the Minnesota Zoo; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+MINNESOTA ZOO; ANIMAL HOSPITAL AND ASSET PRESERVATION. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+(a) $21,475,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Minnesota Zoological Board for capital improvements at the Minnesota Zoo. +]

[+(b) Of this amount, $17,675,000 is to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new animal hospital building at the Minnesota Zoological Garden. +]

[+(c) Of this amount, $3,800,000 is for capital asset preservation improvements and betterments to infrastructure and exhibits at the Minnesota Zoo, to be spent in accordance with Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.307. Notwithstanding the specified uses of money under Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.307, the amount of this appropriation designated for asset preservation may be used to replace buildings that are in poor condition, outdated, and no longer support the work of the Minnesota Zoological Garden and to construct and renovate trails and roads on the Minnesota Zoological Garden site. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $21,475,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new animal hospital and asset preservation at the Minnesota Zoo; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. MINNESOTA ZOO; ANIMAL HOSPITAL AND ASSET PRESERVATION.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

(a) $21,475,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Minnesota Zoological Board for capital improvements at the Minnesota Zoo.

(b) Of this amount, $17,675,000 is to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new animal hospital building at the Minnesota Zoological Garden.

(c) Of this amount, $3,800,000 is for capital asset preservation improvements and betterments to infrastructure and exhibits at the Minnesota Zoo, to be spent in accordance with Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.307. Notwithstanding the specified uses of money under Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.307, the amount of this appropriation designated for asset preservation may be used to replace buildings that are in poor condition, outdated, and no longer support the work of the Minnesota Zoological Garden and to construct and renovate trails and roads on the Minnesota Zoological Garden site.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $21,475,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
